message.name: MPC_TRAJECTORY
message.description: A chunk of an onboard-MPC time-parametrized trajectory (NED, row/local frame), fed raw (un-reshaped) to the position controller. Multiple chunks (start_index 0..num_points) assemble one trajectory identified by traj_id; the chunk with start_index+count==num_points commits it. First cut is NE-only (altitude held).
message.field: Monotonic trajectory id (one per MPC solve). Chunks with a mismatched id are dropped.
Total number of nodes in the full trajectory.
Index of the first node carried in this chunk.
Number of valid nodes in this chunk (1..6).
Nominal node spacing; node i has time start_index_i*dt_ms.
North position of each node (local NED).
East position of each node (local NED).
North kinematic acceleration of each node.
East kinematic acceleration of each node.

Vehicle time_boot_ms of the state used as node 0 (the solve anchor), echoed from LOCAL_POSITION_NED so it stays in the vehicle clock domain. The replay clock starts here, compensating solve+transport latency. 0 = unknown (firmware falls back to arrival time).

Quadratic drag coefficient k/m of the airframe model. The firmware adds drag_k*|v|*v (v = velocity estimate) as thrust-side acceleration feed-forward after the velocity PID, so the accelerations above stay kinematic and the PID only corrects unmodeled effects. 0 disables.
